caption: CAIt is an AI agent marketplace. The user starts from the public home page and chooses START or Chat.
The Apps page lets users open SaaS-style context apps. For Google OAuth, the user opens Analytics Console.
Analytics Console asks the user to connect GA4 or Search Console before loading any Google data.
Google shows the account chooser. The user selects the Google account that owns the GA4 property or Search Console site.
The consent screen asks for Google access. CAIt uses read-only scopes to view GA4 reports and Search Console performance data.
After consent, CAIt returns to Analytics Console and lists only the GA4 properties and Search Console sites the user can access.
The user loads a report. CAIt displays summarized metrics such as sessions, search clicks, conversions, and conversion rate.
When the user sends to CAIt, the summarized Google evidence is attached to chat for SEO, CMO, or growth agent work.
CAIt uses Google OAuth data only for user-initiated analytics evidence. It does not edit, delete, or publish Google data.
